title: DigiCert Announces General Availability of Quantum Central Platform for PQC Migration Management - Quantum Computing Report
gist: DigiCert has made Quantum Central generally available inside DigiCert ONE. The suite gathers an enterprise's cryptographic assets into one inventory, tracks policy compliance and automates remediation for post-quantum cryptography (PQC) migration. It targets the gap between the 87% of enterprises that are planning, testing or executing PQC work and the 7% that have quantum-safe or hybrid cryptography in production.

insights.claim: According to DigiCert's 2026 Quantum Readiness Outlook, 87% of enterprises are actively planning, testing or executing post-quantum cryptography initiatives, but only 7% have deployed quantum-safe or hybrid cryptographic primitives in production.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: An 80-point gap between planning and production deployment points to a large, mostly untapped market for PQC migration tooling and services.
insights.quote: while 87% of enterprises are actively planning, testing, or executing PQC initiatives, only 7% have deployed quantum-safe or hybrid cryptographic primitives into production environments
insights.locator: The release addresses a key gap

insights.claim: Harvest-now, decrypt-later (HNDL) threats, together with regulatory compliance requirements, are the main reasons DigiCert gives for enterprises to build auditable PQC migration programs.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Compliance and audit demands, rather than the arrival of a working quantum computer, may be what drives near-term PQC spending.
insights.locator: Under Senior Director of Product Management

insights.claim: DigiCert Quantum Central is now generally available as part of the DigiCert ONE platform. It works as an orchestration layer that combines cryptographic inventories from network scans, certificate lifecycle management (CLM) platforms, key vaults, software bills of materials (SBOMs) and external APIs into one dashboard.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: DigiCert is positioning itself as the control layer for PQC migration, which could keep enterprises on its platform and grow recurring revenue.
insights.locator: The release addresses a key gap

insights.claim: Quantum Central can export Cryptographic Bills of Materials (CBOMs) through a programmatic API, giving enterprises auditable metrics and records for regulatory compliance.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Watch whether CBOMs become a standard compliance deliverable the way SBOMs did, since that would create demand for tools that generate them.

insights.claim: Quantum Central includes a policy engine that flags assets that do not comply with PQC requirements and opens change requests automatically through Jira. It also has an inventory-aware AI assistant that explores exposure and recommends next steps.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Security vendors are adding AI assistants and workflow integrations to cryptography management, making their products harder to replace.

insights.claim: Quantum Central links policy governance to certificate issuance through DigiCert Trust Lifecycle Manager, DigiCert Private CA and CertCentral. This lets it deploy hybrid and quantum-safe TLS certificates directly, instead of only reporting on risk.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Handling discovery, policy and issuance in one product gives certificate authorities an advantage over vendors that only offer cryptographic discovery.
insights.locator: Under Senior Director of Product Management

insights.claim: Quantum Central supports incremental PQC migration, so organizations can move high-value asset environments first and then expand across the enterprise.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: PQC migration is likely to be phased over several years, so vendor revenue will build gradually rather than arrive in one large upgrade cycle.
insights.locator: Under Senior Director of Product Management
